title: Notion search filtered to object database stops matching after moving to API version 2025-09-03
symptoms: Search with filter value database no longer returns the databases it used to
Search results come back with object data_source instead of database
One database shows up several times in search results
cause: On 2025-09-03 search lists data sources, so the object filter value changed from database to data_source. A database with several sources yields one result per source.
fix: Filter on data_source and group results by parent.database_id when you need one entry per database.
